title: The Lotus Sutra (Fall Class Part 6)
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: In a Soto Zen dharma talk, the teacher invites listeners to embark on a symbolic journey of self-discovery, leaving behind feelings of incompleteness or dissatisfaction with their life. Along the way, they encounter challenges and doubts, but are guided by a compassionate presence that helps them see that true fulfillment was within them all along. Ultimately, this journey reveals that our true nature is already awakened, and that the path to awakening requires patience, guidance, and self-reflection.
